description: This file defines Pydantic models for notification schemas used in the backend API, including base notification data, creation payload, response model, and paginated list response.

classes.name: NotificationBase
classes.description: Base fields for notifications shared across create/update.

classes.name: NotificationCreate
classes.description: Payload to create a notification, inherits from NotificationBase.

classes.name: NotificationOut
classes.description: Notification response model with additional fields like id, sent_at, read_at, and metadata.

classes.name: NotificationListResponse
classes.description: Paginated list of notifications containing items, total, page, and page_size.
